nodes.description: Public mapping (address => Holder) Acc storing each depositor's unlockTime and balance; mutated by Put and Collect.
Log contract reference LogFile, set in the constructor and called by Put and Collect.
Public uint MinSum = 1 ether, the minimum balance required before a Collect is allowed.
Public Message[] History array in Log, appended to by AddMessage.
Storage struct LastMsg in Log used as a scratch buffer before pushing into History.
Public payable Put(uint _unlockTime): credits msg.value to Acc[msg.sender].balance and sets unlockTime to max(_unlockTime, now).
Public payable Collect(uint _am): checks balance, MinSum and now>unlockTime then sends _am to msg.sender via call.value before decreasing the balance.
Fallback function that forwards any plain value transfer into Put(0).
Constructor taking an address and storing it as the LogFile Log contract.
Public AddMessage(address,uint,string): fills LastMsg fields (Time = now) and pushes it into History.
Caller-controlled address used as the key into Acc, as the recipient of the external call and as the logged sender.
Block timestamp (now) used to set the unlock time and to gate the Collect withdrawal.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() low-level external value transfer performed before the balance is decremented; classic reentrancy sink.
acc.balance += msg.value unchecked integer addition on user-supplied value.
acc.balance -= _am unchecked integer subtraction executed after the external call.
acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>now?_unlockTime:now timestamp-dependent assignment controlled by a user parameter.
Condition now>acc.unlockTime (together with acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am) gating the withdrawal; timestamp dependency.
External call LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,value,"...") from Put and Collect to an untrusted Log contract.
Parameter _unlockTime of Put, used to derive the account unlock time.
Parameter _am of Collect, the requested withdrawal amount.
Parameter _adr of AddMessage, written into LastMsg.Sender.
Parameter _val of AddMessage, written into LastMsg.Val.
Parameter _data of AddMessage, written into LastMsg.Data.
Constructor parameter log, the Log contract address assigned to LogFile.
Local storage reference acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Local storage reference acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.

edges.reason: Put executes the unchecked balance increment for the caller's Holder.
Put sets acc.unlockTime from _unlockTime and now.
Put performs the external LogFile.AddMessage call after updating state.
Collect performs the external call.value(_am)() that transfers ether to msg.sender.
Collect decrements acc.balance by _am inside the guarded branch.
Collect evaluates the now>acc.unlockTime time-dependent condition.
Collect calls LogFile.AddMessage after the successful transfer.
Fallback forwards value into Put(0).
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History array.

msg.sender indexes the Acc mapping to obtain the local Holder reference in Collect.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument of the LogFile.AddMessage call.
The caller-controlled msg.sender is the destination of the external value call in Collect.
now (block.timestamp) participates in the ternary that sets acc.unlockTime.
now is compared against acc.unlockTime to authorize the withdrawal.

The _unlockTime parameter flows into the timestamp-dependent unlockTime assignment.
The _am parameter becomes the value sent by the external call.
The _am parameter is subtracted from the stored balance.
Local acc reference is the target of the balance addition in Put.
The incremented balance is written back into the Acc mapping entry.
